map:
CANON SCALE (S1E1 'Currently Publicly Available Information' card, checked on the fandom S1E1 page). The three walls are concentric and 'separated in roughly equal intervals': about 100 km from Wall Maria to Wall Rose, about 130 km from Wall Rose to Wall Sina, and about 250 km from Wall Sina to the centre. That gives radii from the centre of Sina 250 km, Rose 380 km and Maria 480 km, so Maria is about 960 km across. All walls are about 50 m high (S1E1; fandom 'Walls (Anime)'). Ground elevation rises toward the centre, and the land is rich in water, ore and natural gas (S1E2 info card). Pure Titans mostly come at the south, so the southern districts are the most exposed (fandom 'Shiganshina District (Anime)': 'Since Shiganshina was located to the south, Titans usually came to this district's Walls').

DISTRICTS: each district is a half-circle walled outcrop that sticks OUTWARD from its wall, with an outer gate in the outcrop and an inner gate in the main wall. Fandom: 'The district was built within an outcrop of Wall Maria'; Shiganshina has a 'front gate' and a 'back gate'. Wall Maria: SHIGANSHINA is the only district named in the manga or anime, on the SOUTH edge. Quinta (west) exists only in the light novel 'The Harsh Mistress of the City', so label it light-novel-only or leave it off; the other Maria districts are unnamed. Wall Rose: TROST south, KARANES east (the anime fandom page is titled 'Calaneth District'), KROLVA (Klorva) west, UTOPIA north. Wall Sina (Sheena): EHRMICH south, STOHESS east, YARCKEL (Yalkell) west, ORVUD north, with the capital (Mitras) at the centre. All from the fandom 'Walls (Anime)' district table. Only Shiganshina, Trost, Karanes and Stohess appear in S1.

RIVER AND FERRIES: fandom 'Paradis Island' (manga ch.2 p.28) says 'sailless boats guided by pulleys and rails connect some districts by river, such as the boats providing transport between Shiganshina District and Trost District'. One checker said this page does not mention ferries; I checked, and it does. On screen, the anime says only that the ferries went to Wall Rose (fandom 'Fall of Wall Maria (Anime)'). A bird's-eye shot of 'the river flowing through Shiganshina all the way to Trost' was cut from S1E2 and never aired (S1E2 trivia). Place Trost about 100 km due NORTH of Shiganshina, with a river joining them (medium confidence). The flow direction is my own inference (probably southward, since the land rises toward the centre), so don't caption it as 'upriver'.

SHIGANSHINA LAYOUT: a half-circle outcrop south of Wall Maria. The outer SOUTH ('front') gate was kicked in by the Colossal Titan. The inner NORTH ('back') gate in Wall Maria was broken by the Armored Titan. The river runs through the town, with the ferry landing at the inner gate. Eren's tree is on a hill just NORTH of the district, inside Wall Maria (scene.py already puts it there).

TROST LAYOUT: fandom says Trost is 'on the south edge of Wall Rose'. It is a half-circle outcrop. The outer SOUTH gate was kicked in in 850, leaving an 8 m hole (fandom 'Struggle for Trost'). The boulder lies 'in the middle of the city' (S1E10). The inner NORTH gate is where Mikasa dealt with the merchant's oversized cart (S1E6). A Garrison 'harpoon net' made by the technical crew kept Titans clustered by the north gate (S1E9; fandom 'Struggle for Trost'). The Woermann standoff and cannon shot happened 'to the north of the district'. The decoys drew Titans to 'a corner of the Wall, on the other side of Trost' (S1E11), which the event page calls 'the opposite end of the district'; which corner is not stated. The supply HQ is a tall multi-storey depot inside the district. Pyxis gave his speech from the top of the wall, above troops gathered on the inner (Wall Rose) side.

KARANES/CALANETH: 'a town located on the east edge of Wall Rose'. After Trost's outer gate was sealed it 'offered the shortest travel route to Shiganshina' (S1E14; fandom 'Calaneth District (Anime)'). It is a half-circle outcrop whose outer gate faces east into the lost Maria belt.

57TH EXPEDITION ROUTE (fandom '57th Exterior Scouting Mission (Anime)', S1E17, S1E18): the Corps gathered in Karanes in the early morning and left through the outer gate once nearby Titans had been drawn away (128 soldiers). Support squads fought Titans near the start until an abandoned 'old town', and after that Erwin deployed the long-range formation. About an hour into the expedition the Female Titan's horde destroyed the front-right flank, and Erwin changed course. The S1E18 page says 'the formation keeps heading east, contrary to the original plan' and reached a Forest of Giant Trees. Only the centre column entered the forest; everyone else guarded its edges. The Corps then retreated and reached Karanes around noon. The official goal was to plot a route from Karanes to Shiganshina, which means southwest around the ring. The draft placed the forest on that southwest line, but that contradicts S1E18, so I moved it.

FOREST OF GIANT TREES: the trees can exceed 80 m, and this forest was a tourist spot before 845 (S1E18 card). Fandom says only that it lies 'somewhere between Wall Maria and Wall Rose'. My placement, an inference at low confidence: about 20-30 km EAST to EAST-SOUTH-EAST of Karanes, inside the 100 km Maria belt, with a road running through it. Basis: about one hour of travel, with Scout wagons at about 20 km/h (S1E22 card) and horses sustaining about 35 km/h (S1E21 card). Show the green-flare course change as a visible bend on the map. The 845 forest in the S1E1 cold open is a different giant-tree forest outside Wall Maria.

STOHESS: 'located on the east edge of Wall Sina'. It is rich, with segregated wealthy and poor quarters, and has unused tunnels from an abandoned royal underground-city project (S1E23; fandom 'Stohess District (Anime)'). Route: the Scouts 'traveled inwards from Calaneth to Stohess' (fandom 57th event page), about 130 km west across the Wall Rose belt. Annie climbed the Stohess stretch of Wall Sina, and part of that damaged face later fell away to show the buried Wall Titan (S1E25).

PLACES S1 DOES NOT LOCATE (medium or low confidence): the 104th Cadet Corps camp (the 'southern division'; graduates were posted to Trost the next day, so put it in southern Wall Rose near Trost). The disbanding ceremony. The refugee storehouses and the forest where Grisha injected Eren (near where the boats landed, so southern Wall Rose). The Ackerman cabin and the traffickers' hut (forested mountains inside Wall Maria, reached on a house call from Shiganshina; Grisha told Eren to wait 'at the base of the mountain'). The underground cell 'beneath a courtroom' and the trial room. The old Survey Corps HQ (a remodelled old castle) and its dry well. The Survey Corps grounds where Sawney and Beane were kept. The room where Erwin held the night meeting before Stohess.

TERRAIN: rolling farmland and villages inside each wall, plateaus rising toward the centre, scattered forests including giant-tree forests, and abandoned villages and an 'old town' in the Maria belt after 845. 3D SCALE NOTE: at true scale the 50 m walls disappear. Keep the 250:380:480 radius ratio on a compressed overview map, and use separate close-up district sets (Shiganshina at R about 520 m as in scene.py; Trost, Karanes and Stohess built the same way), switching between them with drone dives.

chapters.episodes: S1E6 (flashback); year from fandom 'Paradis Island' ('In 844, human traffickers...') and 'Eren Yeager' (Eren was 9 in 844, manga ch.19 p.26)
chapters.place: Forested mountain area inside Wall Maria: the Ackerman cabin and the traffickers' hut deeper in the woods
chapters.title: The Red Scarf
chapters.caption: 844. Nine-year-old Eren saves Mikasa from traffickers and gives her his scarf.
chapters.what_happens: Grisha brings 9-year-old Eren on a house call to the Ackerman family and finds Mikasa's parents murdered. Traffickers have taken Mikasa to sell her as the last 'Oriental' girl. Grisha goes to report it to the Military Police and tells Eren to wait at the base of the mountain. Eren goes to the traffickers' hut instead. Pretending to be lost, he stabs the first man in the throat, then kills the second with a knife tied to a broom handle. The third man strangles him. Eren shouts at Mikasa to fight, and she stabs the man through the heart from behind. The Military Police are stunned by the scene. Grisha scolds Eren and invites Mikasa to live with them, and Eren wraps his scarf around her. This is the S1E6 flashback, moved to its in-world year as the brief requires, so the video opens here and the year counter only ever moves forward.
chapters.visuals_3d: Optional 3-4 s opening move: start very high over the three rings (Sina, Rose and Maria at a 250:380:480 ratio), then dive to a cold, wooded mountain slope inside southern Wall Maria. Dusk light. Two small log cabins: the Ackerman home and the traffickers' hut. Tiny figures: Grisha with a doctor's bag, Eren, Mikasa and three traffickers, then Military Police with lanterns. No Titans. The red scarf is the hero prop. Keep the violence off-screen at drone distance.
chapters.sources: S1E6 'The World the Girl Saw: The Struggle for Trost, Part 2' (fandom); fandom 'Paradis Island' (844); fandom 'Eren Yeager'

chapters.place: Hill with a lone tree just north of Shiganshina, inside Wall Maria
chapters.title: A Very Long Dream
chapters.caption: 845. Ten-year-old Eren wakes in tears under a tree outside Shiganshina.
chapters.what_happens: While gathering firewood with Mikasa, Eren falls asleep under a tree. He wakes up crying and can't remember the dream. Mikasa asks why he is crying. They carry their firewood frames back toward Shiganshina. The anime's cold open (the Colossal Titan's hand on the Wall, and the Survey Corps attacking a Titan in a forest outside the Walls) does not include Eren, so it is skipped for his point of view.
chapters.visuals_3d: Morning, clear sky, warm light. A drone move from the 844 forest to the farm belt north of Shiganshina: one broad tree on a gentle hill, with two kids (Eren with dark hair and a firewood frame, Mikasa in the red scarf). Behind them, Shiganshina's 50 m half-circle outcrop sticks south out of the line of Wall Maria, with the inner gate and river visible. Tiny Garrison figures on the wall and peaceful chimney smoke. No Titans.
chapters.sources: S1E1 'To You, in 2000 Years: The Fall of Shiganshina, Part 1' (fandom); fandom 'Shiganshina District (Anime)'

chapters.place: Shiganshina: the Garrison post at a gate, then the main street as the Survey Corps returns from beyond the Wall
chapters.title: The Survey Corps Return
chapters.caption: Drunk guards insist the 50 m Wall is safe. Then the Survey Corps return in pieces.
chapters.what_happens: Hannes and the gate guards are drinking on duty. They tell Eren the Wall is 50 m high, taller than any known Titan, and that nothing has happened in 100 years. Eren compares them to caged livestock and says he wants to join the Survey Corps. Bells ring for the Survey Corps' return. Very few have come back. A mother looking for her son Moses is handed only his arm, and Commander Keith Shadis says the expedition achieved nothing. When bystanders complain about wasted tax money, Eren jabs one of them with a firewood stick, and Mikasa drags him away.
chapters.visuals_3d: Morning, which fandom 'Fall of Wall Maria (Anime)' gives as 'the morning before the fall'. The outer south gate rises and a short column of battered riders and wagons of wounded rides north up the main street. Green 'Wings of Freedom' cloaks, a crowd lining the street, and bells swinging in a tower. The drone tracks the column into the town centre. No Titans.
chapters.sources: S1E1 (fandom); fandom 'Fall of Wall Maria (Anime)'

chapters.place: The Yeager house, Shiganshina
chapters.title: Father's Promise
chapters.caption: Grisha leaves on a trip and promises to show Eren the basement when he returns.
chapters.what_happens: At the family meal, Mikasa tells Eren's parents that he wants to join the Survey Corps, and Carla is furious. Grisha asks Eren why. Eren says he wants to know the outside world and doesn't want earlier sacrifices to be in vain. Grisha says human curiosity can't be stopped by a lecture, leaves for a few days to see patients further inside, and promises to show Eren the secret basement when he gets back. Eren tells his mother that living safely like cattle is even more foolish and runs out. Carla asks Mikasa to look after him.
chapters.visuals_3d: Early afternoon. Fandom calls the meal 'dinner', but the attack came 'in the afternoon', so use midday light and don't caption it as dinner. A small two-storey stone-and-timber house in a dense block. Grisha's horse cart rolls north through the inner gate onto the road into Wall Maria. A small basement window on the house can serve as a quiet marker. No Titans.
chapters.sources: S1E1 (fandom); fandom 'Fall of Wall Maria (Anime)'

chapters.place: Back streets and the riverbank in Shiganshina
chapters.title: Armin by the River
chapters.caption: Eren saves Armin from bullies. By the river, they talk about the forbidden outside world.
chapters.what_happens: Bullies are beating Armin for saying humans should go outside the Walls. They run when they see Mikasa behind Eren. That evening by the river, Armin explains that the government has made any interest in the outside world taboo, and he wonders whether the Walls really are safe forever. Optional overlay: the S1E5 memory of Armin's forbidden book about the outside (oceans, lands of ice, fields of sand). It comes from an undated earlier day, while Armin's parents were still alive, so label it as an earlier memory and not as part of 845.
chapters.visuals_3d: Late afternoon into early evening golden light. A stone-banked river through the district with the three kids on the bank, and a quiet town. Optional ghosted overlay of the book's imagery (ocean, ice, dunes), marked as a memory. No Titans yet.
chapters.sources: S1E1 ('Later that evening, as the three sit by the river'); S1E5 'First Battle' memory (fandom)

chapters.place: Shiganshina outer (south, 'front') gate
chapters.title: The Colossal Titan
chapters.caption: A quake and a boom, then a 60 m Titan grips the top of the Wall.
chapters.what_happens: The ground shakes and there is a loud noise. People run into the streets, and Armin is the first to see a giant hand on top of the Wall: a 60 m Titan looking over it. It lifts its leg and drives it through the gate. The remains of the smashed gate and wall fall into the town, crushing houses and people. A horde of Titans pours in through the breach.
chapters.visuals_3d: Late afternoon golden hour. Looking south from the town: steam billows beyond the wall, then a huge skinless head of exposed red muscle, with no lips and bare teeth, rises above the parapet in steam. The kick blasts the gate section inward, and big masonry blocks arc over the rooftops, followed by dust columns. The Colossal disappears into its own steam. Pure Titans of 3-15 m file in. A lightning-like flash is not mentioned in the fandom S1E1 summary, so check the episode before adding one.
chapters.sources: S1E1 (fandom); fandom 'Colossal Titan (Anime)' (60 m); fandom 'Shiganshina District (Anime)'

chapters.place: The Yeager house and nearby streets, Shiganshina
chapters.title: Mother
chapters.caption: Carla is trapped under the house. Hannes escapes with the kids, and a Titan eats her.
chapters.what_happens: A chunk of the shattered gate, thrown by the Colossal's kick, has landed on the Yeager house, pinning Carla. Her legs are crushed, so she says she couldn't walk even if they freed her. Eren and Mikasa can't move the rubble. Hannes arrives and charges the approaching Titan, but stops, horrified by its face. He grabs both children and runs. Over Hannes's shoulder, Eren watches the grinning Titan pull Carla from the rubble and eat her.
chapters.visuals_3d: Late afternoon. A collapsed house under a big stone block from the gate, with dust in the air. The Smiling Titan: very tall and gaunt with visible ribs, an unusually long neck, light hair that only just reaches the neck (not the shoulders), small sunken grey eyes, and a fixed wide grin showing teeth and gums. Canon gives no height, so model it at about 12-15 m as an estimate. Hannes in ODM gear carries two kids north toward the inner gate. Keep the eating off camera.
chapters.sources: S1E1 ('a boulder has landed on his house' after 'remnants of the crushed Wall plummet into the city'); fandom 'Dina Fritz (Anime)' (Titan appearance)

chapters.place: Shiganshina inner (north, 'back') gate in Wall Maria and the ferry landing
chapters.title: The Armored Titan
chapters.caption: As the ferries leave, the Armored Titan smashes the inner gate. Wall Maria falls.
chapters.what_happens: Coming out of shock, Eren punches Hannes for abandoning his mother. Hannes admits he lacked the courage to face the Titan. On the way to the gate, Mikasa gets a headache as she remembers her dead parents. Survivors are packed onto ferries; Armin and his grandfather are already aboard. Hugo's Garrison squad fires the gate cannons without effect, and Hannes and another officer argue over shutting the gate on the people still outside. The episode page says 'comrades' and the event page says 'civilians'. Then the Armored Titan charges through the district and breaks down the inner gate, killing its defenders. On the departing boat, Eren realises he can never go home and swears to kill every Titan.
chapters.visuals_3d: Dusk. Crowded cable-guided ferries at the gate and cannon smoke on the wall. The Armored Titan, 15 m, covered in pale armour plates with blond hair, sprints shoulder-first into the gate, which bursts apart. Titans spill through into the farmland of Wall Maria.
chapters.sources: S1E2 'That Day: The Fall of Shiganshina, Part 2' (fandom, incl. trivia on Hugo); fandom 'Fall of Wall Maria (Anime)'; fandom 'Armored Titan (Anime)' (15 m)

chapters.place: The river route north from Shiganshina toward Wall Rose (landing assumed near Trost)
chapters.title: Wall Maria Is Lost
chapters.caption: Survivors flee by boat to Wall Rose. Humanity abandons a third of its land.
chapters.what_happens: The ferries carry the survivors to Wall Rose while news of Shiganshina's fall spreads. Humanity abandons the Wall Maria territory, about a third of its land, and retreats behind Wall Rose. Meanwhile, Grisha drives his carriage hard along the roads, desperate to reach his family.
chapters.visuals_3d: Night. A big pull-up from burning, smoking Shiganshina, then a flight north along the river to the lights of Wall Rose (Trost). Lamp-lit ferries on the water. Tiny Titan silhouettes fan out over the farmland behind them. Optional: a small carriage racing on a road. Docking at Trost is not shown on screen, so present it as implied rather than as an event.
chapters.sources: S1E2 (fandom; trivia: a cut, never-aired shot of the river from Shiganshina to Trost); fandom 'Paradis Island' (boats between Shiganshina and Trost, ch.2 p.28); fandom 'Fall of Wall Maria (Anime)' (ferries to Wall Rose; one third of territory lost)

chapters.place: A dark forest near the refugee landing in southern Wall Rose (S1 never shows where)
chapters.title: Father's Syringe
chapters.caption: A broken memory: in a dark forest, Grisha injects Eren and gives him the key.
chapters.what_happens: S1 shows this only as Eren's dream and broken memory, which he has while sleeping in the refugee storehouse. Grisha, frantic, hangs the basement key around Eren's neck and injects him. He says the basement holds everything needed to destroy the Titans, that Eren must master this power to protect Mikasa and Armin, and that 'the memories' will teach him how to use it. A bell wakes Eren in the storehouse with the key, and Grisha is gone. Later seasons place this on the night the refugees reached Wall Rose, so frame it as that night. Do not show what happens next; that is revealed in Season 3.
chapters.visuals_3d: Night, a dense dark forest, one lantern and a horse. Two small figures and the glint of the key, then a fade to black. No Titans on screen.
chapters.sources: S1E2; S1E9 'Whereabouts of His Left Arm: The Struggle for Trost, Part 5' (fandom); fandom 'Fall of Wall Maria (Anime)' for timing and place (later-season info)

chapters.place: Refugee food storehouses in southern Wall Rose, near where the ferries landed
chapters.title: Refugees
chapters.caption: Next morning, refugees crowd the Wall Rose storehouses. Food runs short and tempers flare.
chapters.what_happens: Mikasa explains that everyone who came by boat has been gathered in these half-empty food storehouses. In the bread-ration line, Eren hears Garrison soldiers complain that the refugees are eating the stores. He attacks one and is knocked down, and Armin smooths it over. Eren calls Armin weak, and Mikasa tells him the only thing they can do is survive, as Carla wanted. The government sends refugees to cultivate land, but it is not enough.
chapters.visuals_3d: Overcast morning. Rows of large storehouses near a river landing, long ration lines and refugee families. Outside town, crews clear new fields with hand tools. Optional anime-only cameo: Annie in the ration line. No Titans.
chapters.sources: S1E2 (fandom summary and script-notes trivia)

chapters.episodes: S1E2; S1E11 (Pyxis reveals the true purpose)
chapters.place: Out through a Wall Rose gate into the lost Wall Maria territory (gate not specified)
chapters.title: Operation to Retake Maria
chapters.caption: 846. About 250,000 people are sent to retake Wall Maria; about a hundred return.
chapters.what_happens: In 846 the government sends about 250,000 people, mostly refugees and about 20% of the population, to 'retake' Wall Maria. Armin's grandfather goes and dies. Only about a hundred survive. The food shortage eases as a result, and in S1E11 Pyxis admits that was the real purpose. Afterwards, Eren, Mikasa and Armin decide to enlist.
chapters.visuals_3d: Morning: an enormous column of civilians with old muskets, spears and farm tools marches out of a Wall Rose gate onto the plains. A high pull-out over the empty belt with scattered Titans and smoke. End at sunset on the wall with three kids, Armin holding a hat.
chapters.sources: S1E2 (fandom: 'about a hundred survivors from a total of 250 thousand'); S1E11 'Idol: The Struggle for Trost, Part 7' (fandom: 'twenty percent'); fandom 'Walls (Anime)'

chapters.place: 104th Cadet Corps camp (southern division), southern Wall Rose (exact site not stated)
chapters.title: The 104th Cadet Corps
chapters.caption: 847. Eren, Mikasa and Armin enlist, and Commandant Shadis greets them by shouting.
chapters.what_happens: Keith Shadis screams at the new recruits to break them down. He skips the ones who saw the fall of Wall Maria (Annie, Mikasa, Bertholdt, Eren and Ymir) but not Armin. Sasha eats a stolen potato in formation and is made to run until she drops. At dinner, cadets crowd Eren for details of the Colossal and Armored Titans, and he clashes with Jean, who wants a safe Military Police post. Eren meets Marco, Conny, Mina, Reiner, Bertholdt, Annie, Christa and Ymir. Christa brings Sasha bread.
chapters.visuals_3d: Spring morning. Wooden barracks, a mess hall and a parade ground with rows of cadets in brown jackets. Sasha running laps at sunset. No Titans.
chapters.sources: S1E2, S1E3 'A Dim Light Amid Despair: Humanity's Comeback, Part 1' (fandom); fandom 'Cadet Corps (Anime)' (847-850, southern division)

chapters.place: Training grounds: balance rig, forest ODM course, classrooms
chapters.title: Three Years of Training
chapters.caption: Eren masters the ODM gear, learns the nape weak spot, and spars with Annie.
chapters.what_happens: Eren can't stay upright in the ODM balance test. Reiner and Bertholdt tell him how they first met Titans and give him tips. On the final retest Shadis has him swap gear with Thomas Wagner: Eren's fitting was defective, and he balances easily. In class, the cadets learn that Titans regenerate, don't need to eat, and can be killed only by cutting the nape with the two blades. In 850 hand-to-hand training, Annie floors both Eren and Reiner. Eren has a blurry flash of a man with a broom stuck in him, a memory of 844. At dinner he ends a fight with Jean using Annie's disarming move. There are weighted marches throughout.
chapters.visuals_3d: A season timelapse as the counter rolls from 847 to 850. A wooden balance rig with ropes. Cadets on wires through tall pines between wooden Titan cut-outs with nape targets. Snow, then spring. No real Titans. Leave the '1 m x 10 cm' nape size out of S1-dated overlays; it comes from the Season 3 Ep 38 info card.
chapters.sources: S1E3; S1E4 'The Night of the Closing Ceremony: Humanity's Comeback, Part 2'; S1E5 lecture memory (fandom); fandom 'Titan (Anime)' (nape size, Ep 38)

chapters.place: The 104th disbanding ceremony (site not stated), the night before Trost
chapters.title: Graduation Night
chapters.caption: 850. The 104th graduates. Mikasa ranks first and Eren fifth.
chapters.what_happens: The top ten are announced: 1 Mikasa, 2 Reiner, 3 Bertholdt, 4 Annie, 5 Eren, 6 Jean, 7 Marco, 8 Conny, 9 Sasha, 10 Christa. At the party Thomas questions why anyone would join the Survey Corps. Eren argues that abandoning the dead's sacrifice would be a disgrace, and storms out. Armin and Mikasa tell him they will join the Corps too. The three watch a shooting star above the Wall.
chapters.visuals_3d: Night. A torch-lit formation of graduates before a stage, then a lamp-lit hall and the dark outline of Wall Rose under a starfield with a shooting star.
chapters.sources: S1E4 (fandom; top ten from its info card)

chapters.place: Trost District main street and outer (south) gate
chapters.title: The Scouts Ride Out
chapters.caption: Next morning, Erwin, Levi and Hange lead the Survey Corps out of Trost.
chapters.what_happens: Crowds watch the Survey Corps main force (Commander Erwin Smith, Captain Levi, Section Commander Hange) ride through Trost and out on an expedition. Eren is thrilled. Hannes, now a captain, congratulates the trio on graduating and apologises for failing to save Carla five years ago.
chapters.visuals_3d: Bright morning. Trost is a half-circle outcrop on Wall Rose's south side. A cavalry column in green cloaks leaves through the south gate onto the old Wall Maria plains, and the gate closes behind it.
chapters.sources: S1E4; S1E9 (fandom); fandom 'Struggle for Trost' ('The morning after the disbanding...')

chapters.place: Top of Wall Rose above Trost's outer gate (cannon rail)
chapters.title: Five Years Later
chapters.caption: Lightning strikes outside the gate. The Colossal Titan is back and kicks it in.
chapters.what_happens: Graduates including Eren, Conny, Sasha, Thomas and Samuel are servicing the wall cannons. Several say Eren's speech has made them choose the Survey Corps, and Sasha shows off meat stolen from the officers' store. Lightning strikes the ground outside the gate and the Colossal Titan appears. It quickly breaks the gate. Then the heat from its body blows the graduates off the wall. Most anchor themselves to the wall, and Sasha catches Samuel, who was knocked out by falling debris. Eren rallies the others and leaps back onto the wall to face the Colossal.
chapters.visuals_3d: Late morning, clear sky. A lightning bolt and a column of steam outside the gate. The 60 m skinless head rises right in front of the cadets on the 50 m wall top. Order: the kick shatters the gate inward and debris falls into Trost, then the heat shockwave scatters the cadets, who fire ODM anchors into the wall.
chapters.sources: S1E4 (fandom: 'It quickly breaks the gate... and the intense heat... throws the graduates off the Wall'); fandom 'Struggle for Trost' (8 m hole)

chapters.place: Trost wall top, beside the Colossal Titan
chapters.title: Eren vs the Colossal
chapters.caption: Eren goes for the Colossal's nape, but it vanishes into steam.
chapters.what_happens: The Colossal sweeps along the wall top, aiming at the cannons, and Eren realises it is intelligent. He dodges and flies at its nape, but a blast of hot steam slows him, and when he slashes there is nothing there: it has vanished. Pure Titans pour through the breach and the evacuation begins. Commander Pyxis leaves his chess game with Lord Wald and heads for Trost.
chapters.visuals_3d: A huge forearm smashing along the cannon rail and a burst of steam. Eren's thin ODM wires arc into empty air. Below, Titans file through the 8 m hole into the streets.
chapters.sources: S1E5 'First Battle: The Struggle for Trost, Part 1' (fandom)

chapters.place: Trost streets and rooftops in the middle guard zone
chapters.title: Squad 34
chapters.caption: Squad 34 is wiped out. Eren saves Armin and is swallowed whole.
chapters.what_happens: Woermann splits the cadets into squads to cover the evacuation. Eren tells a bitter Jean they will survive this as they survived training. Ian Dietrich reassigns Mikasa to the rear guard. Eren snaps at her when she objects, and she begs him not to die. Squad 34 (Eren, Armin, Thomas, Nack, Milieus, Mina) is sent forward. An Abnormal leaps at them and eats Thomas. Eren charges it, but another Titan bites off his leg, and the rest of the squad is killed. A Titan puts Armin in its mouth. Eren hurls Armin out and props the jaws open with a blade, but it bites off his arm and swallows him.
chapters.visuals_3d: Midday. Titans walking down the streets, cadets on wires, and a lanky Abnormal leaping onto a roof. Eren stranded on a roof, a Titan's mouth closing, and Armin tossed onto the tiles. Keep the gore at drone distance.
chapters.sources: S1E5 (fandom); fandom 'Struggle for Trost'

chapters.place: Trost streets near where Squad 34 fell
chapters.title: Inside the Titan
chapters.caption: Inside the Titan's stomach, Eren's rage erupts. A Titan bursts out of its back.
chapters.what_happens: Without his left arm and a leg, Eren comes to inside the Titan's stomach among dead and dying soldiers, and hears a girl calling for her mother as she sinks. Furious that the Titans have taken everything, he reaches up with his missing arm, vowing to kill them all. A huge arm explodes out of the Titan's mouth and it falls on its face. Eren's Titan tears out of its back, stamps its head to destroy it, then kills a smaller Titan with one punch and keeps stamping in a frenzy. S1 shows this as a memory in Ep 9. In the in-world timeline it falls here, before Eren's Titan rescues Mikasa.
chapters.visuals_3d: A street-level Titan (unnamed, smaller than 15 m) stumbles, and a giant arm bursts from its mouth. Steam and lightning-like light, then the 15 m Attack Titan rising out of its back with a roar. A head-stomp kept at drone distance, and a second smaller Titan dropping.
chapters.sources: S1E9 (fandom summary); fandom 'Attack Titan (Anime)' (15 m)

chapters.place: Trost inner (north) gate, then the rooftops around the supply HQ
chapters.title: Mikasa's Charge
chapters.caption: Mikasa clears the gate, learns Eren is dead, and leads a charge on the HQ.
chapters.what_happens: In S1E6, a merchant's oversized cart blocks the inner gate. Mikasa kills an Abnormal charging the crowd and threatens to execute the merchant until he moves it. The evacuation finishes, the retreat bell rings, and Mikasa goes to help the vanguard instead of climbing the wall. In S1E7, the cadets are stranded and almost out of gas because Titans have overrun the supply HQ. A crying Armin tells Mikasa that Eren is dead. She calls the others cowards and charges the HQ, and Jean rallies everyone to follow. She burns through her gas and crashes onto a market tent.
chapters.visuals_3d: A giant cart jammed in the gate and a packed crowd, then Mikasa's blade arc. Then rooftops: the multi-storey supply HQ with Titans pulling at its windows, and Mikasa falling onto a market tent.
chapters.sources: S1E6; S1E7 'Small Blade: The Struggle for Trost, Part 3' (fandom); fandom 'Struggle for Trost'

chapters.place: Trost market street
chapters.title: A Titan That Hunts Titans
chapters.caption: A strange 15 m Titan appears and starts killing other Titans, saving Mikasa.
chapters.what_happens: Mikasa gives up, then remembers Eren telling her to fight, and raises her blades. Before she strikes, a strange Titan punches the attacking Titan's jaw apart and stamps it to death. It roars, then knocks another Titan's head off with one punch so the head flies into a bell tower, and it ignores the humans. Armin carries Mikasa to a roof and gives her his gas. Viewers don't know yet that it is Eren. Optional cutaway (S1E9): outside the Walls, Erwin sees Titans heading north toward the city and orders the expedition back.
chapters.visuals_3d: Eren's Titan (Attack Titan, 15 m): lean and muscular, shoulder-length dark hair, green eyes, pointed ears, and teeth showing through slits in the cheeks. Punch impacts, a head flying into a bell tower, steam. Optional wide map shot: Titans streaming north while the Survey Corps column turns back.
chapters.sources: S1E7; S1E9 (fandom); fandom 'Attack Titan (Anime)'

chapters.place: Trost supply HQ and the street outside
chapters.title: Resupply
chapters.caption: Using the rogue Titan as cover, the cadets retake the supply HQ. Eren emerges.
chapters.what_happens: Armin's plan: draw the rogue Titan toward the HQ so it fights the Titans there. The cadets crash in through the upper windows. A lift of cadets with old guns acts as bait and blinds the seven 3-4 m Titans in the supply room. Mikasa, Reiner, Annie, Bertholdt, Jean, Conny and Sasha drop from the rafters onto the napes. Sasha and Conny miss, and Mikasa and Annie save them. Everyone refuels. Outside, other Titans pin the rogue Titan and start eating it. It loses both arms charging the Abnormal that ate Thomas, bites through its neck, swings the body into the others, roars and collapses. Eren climbs out of its nape unconscious, with his limbs grown back. Mikasa sobs when she hears his heartbeat. Jean realises Eren caused it all.
chapters.visuals_3d: Afternoon. A cut-away of the HQ interior with muzzle flashes. Outside, the armless 15 m Titan biting into an Abnormal's neck. A huge steam plume, and a small figure being pulled from the nape.
chapters.sources: S1E8 'I Can Hear His Heartbeat: The Struggle for Trost, Part 4' (fandom)

chapters.place: Trost, at the foot of Wall Rose on the north side of the district
chapters.title: Human or Titan?
chapters.caption: The Garrison fires a cannon at Eren. He half-transforms to stop the shot.
chapters.what_happens: Titans are being held by the north gate by the Garrison technical crew's harpoon net. Captain Woermann's troops surround Eren, Mikasa and Armin and threaten them with treason. Mikasa threatens to kill anyone who harms Eren. Eren remembers waking inside the Titan, sees his arm, and realises it wasn't a dream. Asked whether he is human or Titan, he says human. Woermann orders the cannon fired. Eren sees the key, remembers Grisha ('master this power to protect Mikasa and Armin'), bites his hand, and a half-formed Titan catches the cannonball.
chapters.visuals_3d: The three at street level, surrounded by Garrison soldiers on the wall and in the street. Harpoon nets holding Titans near the north gate in the background. A cannon fires. A giant half-skeleton (ribcage, spine, one arm, a skull-like head) forms around the trio and steams.
chapters.sources: S1E9 (fandom); fandom 'Struggle for Trost' (harpoon net; 'to the north of the district')

chapters.place: Inside the steaming half-Titan, then the street, then the top of Wall Rose
chapters.title: Armin's Plea
chapters.caption: Eren offers two plans. Armin salutes and pleads for him, and Pyxis steps in.
chapters.what_happens: Eren pulls himself out of the evaporating half-Titan and offers two plans. One: transform fully and go alone to the basement in Wall Maria. Two: stay, if Armin can convince the Garrison he is humanity's ally. He reminds Armin that he saved them five years ago by sending Hannes after them, and Armin realises they never saw him as a burden. Armin walks out of the steam, salutes, and argues that Eren could help retake Trost. Ian backs him, but Woermann raises his hand to fire again. Commander Dot Pyxis stops him. On the wall, Armin proposes having Eren carry the boulder in the middle of the city to plug the breach. Eren looks back at the land that would be lost and agrees to try.
chapters.visuals_3d: Afternoon. A steaming half-skeleton with three small figures, and Armin saluting before a ring of soldiers and a loaded cannon. Then Pyxis (bald, with a moustache) on the wall top with the three, looking out over Trost toward the breach and back over Wall Rose's farmland.
chapters.sources: S1E10 'Response: The Struggle for Trost, Part 6' (fandom)

chapters.place: Wall top above Trost's inner side and the troops gathered inside Wall Rose
chapters.title: Pyxis's Gamble
chapters.caption: Commander Pyxis bets everything on Eren sealing the gate with a boulder.
chapters.what_happens: Walking the wall top, Pyxis tells Eren a legend of humans uniting against a common enemy. Eren waves off a worried Hannes, then spits out the drink Pyxis offers him. Below, troops begin to desert, and Woermann threatens to execute them. From the top of the wall, Pyxis introduces Eren as a secret weapon and pardons anyone who leaves, but warns that their families would then face the Titans. He tells them the truth about the 846 operation, and most return to their posts. The plan: decoys draw the Titans to a corner on the far side of Trost under cannon fire, while elite Garrison soldiers Ian, Rico and Mitabi escort Eren to the boulder. Eren tells Mikasa she is on the decoy team, but Ian moves her to Eren's escort. On the way, Rico tells Eren that soldiers are not pawns.
chapters.visuals_3d: Afternoon. Pyxis on the wall top above hundreds of soldiers, and a green flare as the operation starts. Optional plan overlay on Trost marking the boulder (mid-city), the 8 m breach, the lure corner on the far side, and the escort route.
chapters.sources: S1E11 (fandom); fandom 'Struggle for Trost' ('a lure on the opposite end of the district'); fandom 'Signal flare (Anime)' (Garrison green = mission started)

chapters.place: The boulder in central Trost
chapters.title: Eren Loses Control
chapters.caption: Eren transforms to lift the boulder, but attacks Mikasa instead.
chapters.what_happens: Eren transforms next to the boulder, looks at it, and attacks Mikasa. She dodges and hangs on his face trying to reach him, and he punches his own head and slumps. Rico fires a red flare to signal failure. The elites talk about abandoning him, but Ian orders them to defend Eren at all costs, and Pyxis keeps the lure going.
chapters.visuals_3d: A lightning bolt for the transformation, then steam. The 15 m Titan beside a huge boulder, and a red smoke flare rising. The decoy fight visible in the distance at the far corner. The boulder's size is not in canon: model it so a 15 m Titan can carry it on its back and so it can plug an 8 m hole (estimate).
chapters.sources: S1E11; S1E12 'Wound: The Struggle for Trost, Part 8' (fandom); fandom 'Signal flare (Anime)'

chapters.place: Trost lure corner and the boulder site
chapters.title: Armin Reaches Eren
chapters.caption: Armin stabs Eren's nape and reminds him why he wants to see outside.
chapters.what_happens: Luring the Titans costs about a fifth of the men. Jean's ODM gear breaks and he runs on foot. Armin reaches the slumped Titan and drives his blade into the nape, through Eren's left arm inside, wounding him without killing him, then shouts to him. In a dream of home, Eren doesn't understand, until Armin asks why he wanted to go outside. Eren answers, 'Because I was born into this world,' the dream bursts into flames, and his Titan wakes. Cutaway (S1E13 start): Marco, Conny and Annie help Jean get a dead soldier's gear. This is the last time Marco is seen alive.
chapters.visuals_3d: Titans packed into one corner under cannon fire from the wall, Jean scrambling at street level, and Armin kneeling on the nape of the slumped Titan. Its eyes light up.
chapters.sources: S1E12 (fandom: 'leading the blade through Eren's left arm'); S1E13 'Primal Desire: The Struggle for Trost, Part 9' (fandom)

chapters.place: Trost streets from the boulder to the outer (south) gate
chapters.title: The Boulder
chapters.caption: Eren carries the boulder to the gate while his escort dies holding off Titans.
chapters.what_happens: Eren lifts the boulder and walks toward the gate. Ian orders everyone to protect him with their lives. Rico's squad is almost wiped out. Mitabi's squad fights on the ground as decoys, and Mitabi is crushed by a Titan's hand. Ian dies pulling a comrade out of a Titan's mouth. Eren tells himself that people are born free and that seeing the outside world would make him the freest of all. Rico cuts the last Titan in the way through the eye and Mikasa finishes it. Eren drops the boulder into the hole and seals it, and Rico fires a yellow flare for success.
chapters.visuals_3d: Late afternoon. A steaming Titan carrying a giant boulder on its back, small soldiers dying in the streets, the boulder slamming into the gap in the gate, and yellow smoke rising.
chapters.sources: S1E13 (fandom); fandom 'Signal flare (Anime)' (yellow = success)

chapters.place: The sealed gate, then all of Trost (Days 0-2)
chapters.title: Humanity's First Victory
chapters.caption: Levi arrives, Trost is cleared, two Titans are captured, and the dead are collected.
chapters.what_happens: Day 0: Rico cuts the unconscious Eren out of the nape. Two Titans close in, and Captain Levi kills them both: the Survey Corps is back. Day 0 to Day 1: the Garrison's explosive shells and the Survey Corps clear Trost over the rest of that afternoon and all of the next day, and two Titans are captured alive. It is humanity's first victory: 207 soldiers dead or missing and 897 wounded, with no civilian deaths in the evacuation. Day 2: the dead are collected for cremation, and Jean finds Marco's body. Nobody knows how he died.
chapters.visuals_3d: Levi standing on a steaming corpse with the Wings of Freedom on his back. Day 1: cannon smoke and Scouts sweeping the streets. Two captured Titans of 4 m and 7 m tied down. Day 2: pyre smoke, carts of bodies and cleanup crews. Optional day labels under the 850 counter.
chapters.sources: S1E13 (fandom); fandom 'Struggle for Trost' and 'Battle of Trost District' (afternoon plus following day; corpses 'on the day after'; casualties)

chapters.episodes: S1E13 (end: cell, Day 3), S1E14 (trial, some days later)
chapters.place: Underground cell beneath a courtroom, then the military court (location not stated)
chapters.title: The Trial
chapters.caption: In military court, Levi beats Eren to win him for the Survey Corps.
chapters.what_happens: Three days after the battle, Eren wakes chained in an underground cell. Erwin is holding his key, and Levi says he will take charge of Eren and kill him if he betrays them. Some days later, Pyxis and Erwin meet on the wall during Pyxis's morning walk. Hange and Mike escort Eren to court, and Mike sniffs him. Premier Dhalis Zachary presides. Nile Dawk of the Military Police wants Eren examined and then disposed of, and Pastor Nick demands he be executed at once. Erwin asks to make Eren a Scout and retake Wall Maria by an eastern route, since Trost's gate is sealed. A merchant lobbies to seal every gate instead, and Levi mocks him. Mikasa confirms that Eren attacked her but says he saved her twice. Nile brings up the children killing three robbers, and Eren explodes. Levi beats him savagely, knocking out a tooth. Erwin proposes that the next expedition decide whether Eren is friend or foe, and Zachary hands him to the Survey Corps on that condition. Afterwards Erwin apologises, Levi asks if Eren hates him, and Hange finds the tooth has grown back.
chapters.visuals_3d: Mostly an interior beat. For the drone: a stone courthouse with a barred cellar window at night, then a dawn cutaway of Pyxis and Erwin on a wall top. No Titans.
chapters.sources: S1E13; S1E14 'Can't Look into His Eyes Yet: Eve of the Counterattack, Part 1' (fandom); fandom 'Struggle for Trost' ('three days after the battle... some days later')

chapters.place: Old Survey Corps HQ, a remodelled old castle in Wall Rose territory (location not stated)
chapters.title: Special Operations Squad
chapters.caption: Eren joins Levi's squad at an old castle, guarded by the people who'd kill him.
chapters.what_happens: Eren rides to the old castle HQ with Levi's Special Operations Squad: Petra, Oruo, Eld and Gunther. Oruo bites his tongue on horseback. Levi orders the filthy castle cleaned, and Eren has to sleep in the basement. Petra tells him Levi was once a thug before Erwin recruited him. Hange asks Eren to help with 'tomorrow's experiment' and talks all night about the captured Titans, Sawney (4 m) and Beane (7 m).
chapters.visuals_3d: Daytime. A small weathered castle with a tower, stables and a courtyard in wooded country, with horses arriving. No Titans.
chapters.sources: S1E15 'Special Operations Squad: Eve of the Counterattack, Part 2' (fandom); fandom 'Sawney (Anime)', 'Beane (Anime)'

chapters.place: Survey Corps research grounds where Sawney and Beane were held (location not stated)
chapters.title: Who Is the Enemy?
chapters.caption: Next morning, the captured Titans are found dead. Erwin asks Eren: who is the enemy?
chapters.what_happens: After Hange's all-night talk, word comes that Sawney and Beane have been killed by someone who escaped using ODM gear. Hange is devastated. Erwin quietly asks Eren what he sees and who the enemy is, then apologises for the strange question. The cadets' gear is inspected for unauthorised use.
chapters.visuals_3d: Morning. Two Titan skeletons steaming in their restraints inside a stockade, soldiers crowding around, and a small lookout tower.
chapters.sources: S1E15; S1E16 'What Needs to be Done Now: Eve of the Counterattack, Part 3' (fandom); fandom '57th Exterior Scouting Mission (Anime)'

chapters.place: Regiment selection ceremony (night), then the old castle HQ (next day)
chapters.title: Joining the Scouts
chapters.caption: Erwin's speech wins over Eren's friends. They join the Scouts and bring news of Marco.
chapters.what_happens: Later that day, at the ceremony where cadets choose their branch, Erwin reveals the goal of reaching Eren's basement in Shiganshina and warns that 60% of Scouts have died in the last four years. Most cadets leave. That night 18 stay and salute, including Mikasa, Armin, Jean, Conny, Sasha, Reiner, Bertholdt, Christa and Ymir. The next day they meet Eren at the castle. Mikasa vows revenge on Levi for the beating. Eren is shocked that Jean has joined and more shocked to learn Marco is dead. Jean makes Eren admit that he attacked Mikasa and can't control his power, then decides to count on him anyway.
chapters.visuals_3d: Night: a torch-lit square with Erwin on a stage as most cadets walk away and a small group stays saluting. Next day: green cloaks handed out in the castle courtyard.
chapters.sources: S1E16 (fandom); fandom '57th Exterior Scouting Mission (Anime)' ('Eighteen cadets... The next day, the new recruits met Eren at the castle')

chapters.place: A dry well and the grounds near the old HQ
chapters.title: The Teaspoon
chapters.caption: Eren can't transform in the well, then half-transforms reaching for a spoon.
chapters.what_happens: This happens during the month before the expedition. Levi explains that if Eren goes berserk they will cut him out of his Titan, and that he picked the squad precisely because they don't trust Eren. Hange has Eren try to transform in a dry well so he can be held if he loses control, but he can't. Later, reaching for a dropped teaspoon, he suddenly half-transforms. The squad draws blades on him until Levi calms them. Hange notices the Titan hand is holding the spoon gently and concludes that transforming needs a clear goal as well as self-injury. The squad bite their own hands as an apology, and Petra asks Eren to rely on them. The anime shows this as a flashback in Ep 19.
chapters.visuals_3d: A grassy field with a deep stone well and a signal flare. Later, a giant arm and upper torso bursting up beside an outdoor table, with steam and soldiers with blades drawn.
chapters.sources: S1E19 'Bite: The 57th Exterior Scouting Mission, Part 3' (fandom); fandom '57th Exterior Scouting Mission (Anime)' (the month after the ceremony)

chapters.place: Karanes (Calaneth) District on the east side of Wall Rose: the outer gate, then an abandoned old town
chapters.title: The 57th Expedition
chapters.caption: A month later, the Survey Corps leaves Karanes for a trial run toward Shiganshina.
chapters.what_happens: Trost's gate is sealed, so the Corps sets out from Karanes in the east. The official goal is to plot a route to Shiganshina. Only veterans from before 845 know the secret goal of catching a Titan-shifter spy. The Corps gathers at dawn, bells ring and the gate opens, and 128 soldiers ride out. Just outside, Mike smells an approaching Titan, and a support squad peels off to deal with it. The support squads cover them only as far as an abandoned old town. After it, Erwin orders the long-range formation and the friends split up.
chapters.visuals_3d: Early morning. Karanes as a half-circle outcrop on Wall Rose's east side. The gate opens to the east, cavalry and supply wagons pour out, a small fight near the gate, then the column rides through the ruins of an abandoned town.
chapters.sources: S1E16; S1E17 'Female Titan: The 57th Exterior Scouting Mission, Part 1' (fandom); fandom '57th Exterior Scouting Mission (Anime)'; fandom 'Calaneth District (Anime)'

chapters.place: Open plains of the former Wall Maria territory, east of Karanes
chapters.title: Long-Range Scouting Formation
chapters.caption: Spread across the plains, the Scouts pass coloured smoke to steer around Titans.
chapters.what_happens: The riders spread into a wide semicircle that works like a human radar. Red smoke means a Titan and black means an Abnormal, and Erwin fires green to set a new heading, which is relayed down the line. Eren rides with Levi's squad in the centre rear, the safest spot, while other soldiers were given false maps of where he was. Armin, on the right flank, relays red flares. In a small village, a crawling Titan inside the formation chases Sasha until her team leader lures it into a tree.
chapters.visuals_3d: Very high drone shot. Dozens of riders hundreds of metres apart in a crescent several kilometres wide. Columns of red, black and green smoke relayed in sequence. Titans of 3-15 m dotted over the hills, with the formation bending around them. Late morning, broken clouds.
chapters.sources: S1E17 (fandom and info card); fandom 'Signal flare (Anime)'; fandom '57th Exterior Scouting Mission (Anime)'

chapters.place: Front-right flank of the formation
chapters.title: The Female Titan
chapters.caption: A 14 m Titan that can think tears through the right flank, hunting Eren.
chapters.what_happens: A horde of Titans that arrives with a female-shaped Titan wipes out most of the far right wing. Ness and Cis kill an Abnormal, then spot what they call a '14-meter class' Abnormal. It kills them both, then lifts Armin's hood to see his face and leaves him alive. Armin realises it is a human who can become a Titan, like Eren, and that it is looking for Eren. Reiner and Jean join him, and they attack with hoods up. As she is about to catch Jean, Armin bluffs: 'Jean! Avenge that suicidal bastard!', claiming she has already killed Eren, and she freezes. Reiner is grabbed but cuts his way out of her hand. She turns and runs toward the centre rear.
chapters.visuals_3d: The Female Titan: 14 m, athletic female build, blond hair, muscle showing through on the face and body, running at full speed. Black smoke, scattered horses and fallen riders.
chapters.sources: S1E17 (fandom: 'avenge that suicidal maniac'); fandom '57th Exterior Scouting Mission (Anime)' ('that suicidal bastard' bluff); fandom 'Female Titan (Anime)' (14 m)

chapters.place: The Forest of Giant Trees (80 m+ trees) in the Wall Maria belt, after the course change
chapters.title: Into the Forest
chapters.caption: Erwin changes course and sends only the centre column into the Forest of Giant Trees.
chapters.what_happens: Jean fires an emergency flare, and Christa arrives with spare horses for Armin's group. Instead of a retreat, the formation changes course. Fandom says it 'keeps heading east, contrary to the original plan'. The Female kills Darius's team. At the Forest of Giant Trees, only the centre column rides in along its road. Everyone else waits in the trees around the edge while Titans gather below. Inside, Levi tells a confused Eren to think for himself. A black flare goes up right behind Levi's squad, the Female bursts out of the trees, and she cuts down the soldiers who try to stop her. Levi tells his squad to cover their ears and fires a sound flare.
chapters.visuals_3d: Midday, dappled light. A course-change bend on the overview map, then an 80 m forest with trunks tens of metres wide and a road through it. Purple and green smoke over the plains, Scouts perched high around the edge, Titans clustering below, and the Female charging down the road behind a group of riders.
chapters.sources: S1E18 'Forest of Giant Trees: The 57th Exterior Scouting Mission, Part 2' (fandom and info card); fandom 'Forest of Giant Trees (Anime)'; fandom 'Signal flare (Anime)' (purple = emergency)

chapters.place: Deep in the forest at the trap site
chapters.title: The Trap
chapters.caption: Eren trusts his squad and keeps riding. The Female runs into Erwin's trap.
chapters.what_happens: Levi offers Eren a choice: trust the squad, or transform and fight alone. Eren chooses the squad and keeps riding as the soldiers behind them die. At the trap, Erwin signals, and veterans in the trees fire hundreds of wire-tipped spears from the new special target restraining weapons, pinning the Female mid-stride. Levi hands the squad to Eld and goes to join Erwin.
chapters.visuals_3d: Clusters of launch barrels in the trees fire dozens of steel cables that converge on the Female and freeze her mid-stride. Smoke, and Levi on a branch above.
chapters.sources: S1E19 (fandom); fandom '57th Exterior Scouting Mission (Anime)'

chapters.place: The trap site, the forest edge and the forest road
chapters.title: The Scream
chapters.caption: Trapped, the Female screams. Titans swarm in to eat her as the person inside escapes.
chapters.what_happens: Eld works out that Erwin told only veterans from before 845 because he suspected a spy. Now Erwin's 'who is the enemy?' makes sense to the squad. The Female hardens the skin over her nape, so Levi's and Mike's blades can't cut it, and Erwin calls for explosives. Levi threatens her. She screams, and Titans from all around ignore the soldiers and run into the forest to eat her. Erwin orders the soldiers to fight them off, then signals a retreat and has Levi resupply. The person inside escapes in the steam wearing a Survey Corps uniform, fires a flare that Levi's squad mistakes for his, and kills Gunther.
chapters.visuals_3d: The pinned Female, with Titans of every size running in through the trees from all sides. A huge steam cloud and a blue retreat flare over the canopy. Gunther hanging from his wire on a trunk.
chapters.sources: S1E20 'Erwin Smith: The 57th Exterior Scouting Mission, Part 4' (fandom); fandom 'Signal flare (Anime)' (blue = retreat, S1E20); fandom '57th Exterior Scouting Mission (Anime)'

chapters.place: Forest road near the trap
chapters.title: Squad Levi Falls
chapters.caption: Levi's squad is killed. Eren transforms in a rage and loses.
chapters.what_happens: The attacker transforms again. Eren is ordered to keep riding while the squad fights, and Petra and Oruo cut out her eyes. She heals one eye first, bites Eld in half, crushes Petra against a tree with her foot, and kills Oruo with a kick after his blades shatter on her hardened nape. Eren transforms and they fight. He breaks his hands on her and starts losing control, twitching and mouthing his thoughts. Her hardened punch tears his mouth, and his uppercut throws her into the air. When he recognises a familiar fighting stance, he freezes. A hardened roundhouse kick takes off his Titan's head, and she bites Eren out of the nape and runs. Mikasa arrives and chases her, and Levi follows.
chapters.visuals_3d: Two 14-15 m Titans brawling between 80 m trees, splintering trunks. A crystal-white hardened fist and shin. Eren's headless Titan collapsing in steam, and Mikasa racing on her wires.
chapters.sources: S1E21 'Crushing Blow: The 57th Exterior Scouting Mission, Part 5' (fandom); fandom '57th Exterior Scouting Mission (Anime)' (stance recognition)

chapters.place: Forest near its edge
chapters.title: Levi's Rescue
chapters.caption: Levi cuts the Female to pieces and pulls Eren from her mouth.
chapters.what_happens: Mikasa draws the Female's attention while Levi slices her apart too fast for her to harden. When Mikasa goes for the kill against orders, Levi shields her and twists his ankle. He cuts Eren out of the Female's mouth and they fall back. Looking back, Levi sees the Female shedding a tear.
chapters.visuals_3d: Levi's spiralling cuts trailing steam, the Female slumped against a trunk guarding her nape, and Levi flying off on his wires carrying Eren.
chapters.sources: S1E22 'The Defeated: The 57th Exterior Scouting Mission, Part 6' (fandom)

chapters.place: Plains back to Karanes, then Karanes' streets (about noon)
chapters.title: Return in Defeat
chapters.caption: They dump the dead to escape Titans, then return to Karanes to jeers.
chapters.what_happens: Against orders, Dieter brings his friend Ivan's body along, and Titans chase the column. Dieter's friend Jurgen is killed. Levi orders the corpses dumped to lighten the wagons, his own squad's among them. Later he gives Dieter a patch 'from Ivan'. Eren dreams of the 845 Survey Corps return and holds himself back from hitting the heckler, then wakes on a wagon beside Mikasa. Around noon they reach Karanes to a jeering crowd. Eren notices two children admiring the Scouts. Petra's father, not knowing she is dead, talks to Levi about her letter. Eren breaks down crying, and Mikasa holds his hand. Erwin is summoned to the capital and Eren is to be handed over.
chapters.visuals_3d: Wagons racing over the plains, shrouded bodies tumbling off, and Titans stopping to grab them. Then the Karanes gate and a crowd lining the street.
chapters.sources: S1E22 (fandom); fandom '57th Exterior Scouting Mission (Anime)' ('Around noon...')

chapters.place: A room in Wall Rose after the return (not shown where)
chapters.title: The Suspect
chapters.caption: That night, Erwin names a suspect: Annie. The plan is to seize her in Stohess.
chapters.what_happens: That night, while they wait for Erwin, Eren apologises to Levi for his choice in the forest. Levi says no one could have predicted the outcome. Erwin, Armin and Mikasa arrive. Erwin names their suspect as Annie, from Armin's deductions about her letting him live and her presenting Marco's gear. The plan is to capture her in Stohess in two days, while the Corps escorts Eren to the capital. Eren is horrified but agrees.
chapters.visuals_3d: Night. A single lamp-lit window in a stone building, then the convoy route drawn on the overview map from Karanes west across the Wall Rose belt to Stohess on Wall Sina.
chapters.sources: S1E24 'Mercy: Assault on Stohess, Part 2' flashback (fandom); fandom '57th Exterior Scouting Mission (Anime)' ('That night... in two days'; 'traveled inwards from Calaneth to Stohess')

chapters.place: Stohess District (east side of Wall Sina): an alley and the stairway into the old underground tunnels
chapters.title: Annie at the Stairs
chapters.caption: In Stohess, Annie won't go into the tunnel. Her secret is out.
chapters.what_happens: The Military Police escort the Survey Corps convoy into Stohess, with Jean in the carriage disguised as Eren. Armin asks Annie to help Eren escape. She agrees, slips on a ring, and leads them to the tunnel stairway, but refuses to go down. Armin says the gear she presented was Marco's. Annie laughs and says Armin has won his bet. Armin fires a flare, and hidden Scouts pin and gag her, but she uses the blade hidden in her ring to transform. Mikasa drags Eren and Armin into the tunnel to shield them from the blast.
chapters.visuals_3d: Daytime. A dense, wealthy stone city with church spires, an empty side street, and a stone stairway down into a tunnel. Then lightning and a tower of light and dust above the rooftops.
chapters.sources: S1E23 'Smile: Assault on Stohess, Part 1' (fandom); fandom 'Stohess District (Anime)'

chapters.place: Stohess streets and the tunnels below
chapters.title: Eren Transforms
chapters.caption: At first Eren can't transform. Buried under rubble, he finally does and punches Annie.
chapters.what_happens: The Female stamps through the tunnel roof, killing two Scouts, and Eren's bites won't trigger a transformation. Mikasa and Armin go up to fight. Annie kicks in the roof and buries Eren. Jean drops his disguise, and Nile's Military Police hold Erwin and Levi at gunpoint. Hange's restraining weapons and a barbed net pin Annie between buildings for a moment, but she kicks free. Trapped under rubble with a piece of wood through his chest, Eren remembers Armin's words about sacrifice, pushes himself off the wood, transforms, and punches Annie into a building.
chapters.visuals_3d: The Female crashing through rooftops, cable lines and a net, dust. A transformation lightning column bursting up from under a street, then the Attack Titan sprinting in and punching her into a facade.
chapters.sources: S1E24 (fandom)

chapters.place: Stohess streets, a church of the Wall cult, toward Wall Sina
chapters.title: Titans in Stohess
chapters.caption: The fight levels streets in Stohess. A church collapses on the worshippers.
chapters.what_happens: The Female crashes onto a Wall-cult church during a service and runs for the Wall, with Eren chasing her through crowds of civilians. He throws her into a building. Military Police recruits Hitch and Marlo watch. Nile calls Erwin a traitor and has him handcuffed. Annie's hardened side kick takes off Eren's lower right leg, and her hardened fists beat him down. Then his Titan flares into a burning rage form, tackles her from behind and crushes her face.
chapters.visuals_3d: A collapsing church and two Titans ploughing a trench of rubble through the city. Eren's Titan wrapped in heat and steam with stretched strands of flesh. Huge dust clouds in afternoon light.
chapters.sources: S1E25 'Wall: Assault on Stohess, Part 3' (fandom)

chapters.place: Wall Sina at Stohess
chapters.title: The Climb
chapters.caption: Annie climbs Wall Sina. Mikasa cuts her fingers off and she falls.
chapters.what_happens: Annie climbs Wall Sina by driving hardened fingers into it, and sacrifices her lower right leg to escape Eren's last grab. Mikasa cuts off the fingers of both her hands and she falls. Eren pins her, tears off her head and right arm (losing his own other arm), and bites open the nape. When he sees Annie crying, he stops. She seals herself in hard crystal as the two Titan bodies start to fuse, and Levi cuts Eren out.
chapters.visuals_3d: The 50 m wall with handholds punched into it, Mikasa landing on the Female's face, the fall. Eren pinning her, and a translucent bluish-white crystal growing around a small figure as the two Titan bodies merge.
chapters.sources: S1E25 (fandom)

chapters.place: The damaged face of Wall Sina at Stohess
chapters.title: A Titan in the Wall
chapters.caption: Annie is sealed in crystal, and inside the cracked Wall, a Titan's face appears.
chapters.what_happens: Eren comes to and watches Jean fail to break the crystal. Hange has it wrapped in a wire net and taken underground, and Erwin answers to the mayor of Stohess. Later, in bed, Armin tells Eren he is the one who let this happen. Eren admits he couldn't move when he saw Annie, and he confides in Mikasa. At the hearing, Erwin says this is the moment humanity's counterattack on the Titans begins. In the last shot, part of the damaged Wall crumbles away to reveal a Titan inside.
chapters.visuals_3d: Slow push-in to where Annie climbed. Chunks of stone fall away to reveal a huge Titan face set into the wall (Wall Titans are about wall height, up to 50 m). Keep the face static; the eye that follows the Scouts and Pastor Nick's reaction belong to S2E26. Evening light, then the end card.
chapters.sources: S1E25 (fandom); fandom 'Wall Titan (Anime)' (up to 50 m; eye and Nick in Ep 26)

titans:
These are the named and notable Titans seen in S1. Heights are from fandom anime infoboxes unless marked otherwise.

COLOSSAL TITAN: 60 m (S1E1). No skin and exposed red muscle, no lips so the teeth show, sparse hair, and huge amounts of steam and heat. In 845 it breaks Shiganshina's outer ('front', south) gate with a kick after a quake and a boom. Whether there is a flash there is unverified. In 850 lightning strikes outside Trost before it appears; it kicks in the gate, its heat blows the cadets off the wall, and it then sweeps the cannon rail (S1E4-5). Both times it vanishes in steam.

ARMORED TITAN: 15 m. Pale armour plates over its body, blond hair. It breaks Shiganshina's inner ('back') gate in Wall Maria (S1E2), and appears only in 845 in S1.

ATTACK TITAN (Eren's): 15 m (S1E7, S1E10). Lean and muscular, shoulder-length dark hair, green eyes, pointed ears, and teeth showing through slits in the cheeks. First seen bursting out of the back of the Titan that swallowed Eren (S1E9 memory). It rampages through Trost (S1E7-8), carries the boulder (S1E13), fights the Female in the forest (S1E21) and in Stohess (S1E24-25), where it flares into a burning rage form. The figure of 20 Titans killed in Trost comes from the manga (ch.19 p.39, fandom 'Battle of Trost District'); it is not confirmed as an anime line, so don't caption it as S1E14. Partial forms: a half-Titan skeleton (ribcage, spine, one arm, skull) that blocks the cannonball (S1E9), and an arm and upper torso near the castle (S1E19 flashback).

FEMALE TITAN (Annie): 14 m (S1E17; Ness calls her a '14-meter class'). Athletic female build, blond hair, muscle showing through the skin on the face and body. She can harden parts of her body to crystal-white (fist, shin, nape), lets out a scream that draws Titans (S1E20), heals body parts selectively (one eye first, S1E21), and finally seals herself in crystal (S1E25).

THE SMILING TITAN that eats Carla (DINA FRITZ, named only in later seasons; don't name her in S1): 'very tall', with no height in canon, so model it at about 12-15 m as an estimate. Thin and emaciated with visible ribs, an unusually long neck, medium-length light hair that only just reaches the neck, small sunken grey eyes, and a permanent wide grin showing teeth and gums (S1E1).

SAWNEY: 4 m, and BEANE: 7 m (S1E15). Captured alive in Trost (S1E13), used in Hange's experiments, and killed in secret (S1E15).

Other Trost Titans: seven 3-4 m Titans in the supply HQ storeroom (S1E8). THE ABNORMAL THAT ATE THOMAS (unnamed, lanky, leaps onto roofs, S1E5): Eren's Titan bites through its neck (S1E8). The Titan that swallows Eren (unnamed, S1E5), and a smaller Titan Eren kills with one punch after emerging (S1E9). Titans held by the Garrison harpoon net near the north gate (S1E9). Two Titans Levi kills at the sealed gate (S1E13).

57th expedition: an Abnormal killed by Ness and Cis (S1E17), a crawling Titan that chases Sasha in a village (S1E17), the horde the Female brings into the right flank (S1E17), and Titans that swarm into the forest to eat her (S1E20) or chase the corpse wagons (S1E22).

PURE TITANS in general: 3-15 m (fandom 'Titan (Anime)'). Naked and human-shaped, they regenerate, steam when wounded, don't need to eat, and die only from cutting out the nape (S1E5 lecture). The nape size of '1 m high and 10 cm across' is from the Ep 38 (Season 3) info card, so keep it out of S1-dated captions. Abnormals move erratically and are flagged with black smoke.

WALL TITAN: about wall height, up to about 50 m (fandom 'Wall Titan (Anime)'). Its face is revealed inside the damaged Wall Sina at Stohess in the last shot of S1 (S1E25). Keep it static; the moving eye belongs to S2E26.

SMOKE COLOURS (fandom 'Signal flare (Anime)'). Garrison in Trost: green for mission started (S1E11), red for failed (S1E12), yellow for success (S1E13). Scouts on the 57th: red for a Titan, black for an Abnormal, green for a course change (S1E17), purple for an emergency (S1E18), blue for retreat (S1E20), yellow for mission terminated. Plus Levi's sound (acoustic) shell (S1E18).
open_questions: Chapter 1 is now the 844 Mikasa rescue. Both checkers and the brief ask for flashbacks at their in-world year, so the year counter only ever moves forward (844 to 850). The alternative is to open with the 845 tree as the anime does and show 844 with an explicit memory card. Please confirm.

Spoilers. Keep Season 2-4 facts out of Part 1: Grisha being eaten after the injection, the Reiss chapel, Reiner, Bertholdt and Annie killing Marco, Annie's role in 845, Dina Fritz's name, and the Wall Titan's moving eye. Chapter 10 uses the later-season timing (the night the refugees reached Wall Rose) but reveals nothing else. Confirm that this is acceptable.

The Forest of Giant Trees has been moved to about 20-30 km east to east-south-east of Karanes. Fandom S1E18 says 'the formation keeps heading east, contrary to the original plan', and the forest is reached about an hour in. The distance is my inference from the S1E21 and S1E22 speed cards, and the exact spot is not canon (low confidence).

One checker said fandom 'Paradis Island' does not mention the ferries. I checked: it does ('sailless boats guided by pulleys and rails... between Shiganshina District and Trost District', manga ch.2 p.28). The anime itself only says the ferries went to 'Wall Rose', and the S1E2 river shot from Shiganshina to Trost was cut. So docking at Trost is implied, not shown, and the flow direction is my inference.

Hannes's gate argument (S1E2): the fandom episode page says closing the gate on 'comrades', while the event page and script trivia say 'civilians'. The chapter uses the neutral wording 'the people still outside'. Check the episode before writing a specific caption.

Shiganshina in 845: fandom mentions only a quake and a loud noise, not a flash. The caption now reads 'A quake and a boom'. Check S1E1 before adding a lightning flash, which is confirmed only for Trost in S1E4.

The draft's '20 Titans' figure is a manga number (ch.19 p.39), not confirmed as said in the S1E14 trial, so it was removed from the captions. Likewise, the 1 m x 10 cm nape size comes from the Ep 38 info card, not S1.

The 128-soldier figure for the 57th expedition and Trost's 207 dead or missing and 897 wounded come from the fandom anime event pages. They may not be spoken on screen, so use them in overlays only if you accept the event pages as a source.

S1 never locates the refugee storehouses, Grisha's forest, the training camp, the graduation site, the trial courthouse and cell, the old Survey Corps castle and its well, the stockade where Sawney and Beane were kept, or the room used for the pre-Stohess meeting. They are placed in southern Wall Rose near Trost or simply 'Wall Rose territory', at medium or low confidence.

Trost: which corner was used for the lure ('a corner of the Wall, on the other side of Trost', S1E11) is not stated. The boulder's size and exact spot ('in the middle of the city') are also modelling estimates.
The Smiling Titan's height is not in canon. About 12-15 m is a modelling estimate ('very tall').

Year counter: S1 gives relative timing within 850. Day 0 is the Trost breach and the boulder. Day 1 is clearing the district. Day 2 is collecting the dead and finding Marco. Day 3 Eren wakes in the cell, and the trial is 'some days later'. Then the recruitment day, the reunion the next day, the expedition about a month later, the return around noon, the meeting that night, and Stohess two days later. Decide whether to show day and month labels under the year.

How many non-Eren cutaways to keep: Mikasa at the gate (S1E6), the Survey Corps turning back (S1E9), Jean, Marco, Conny and Annie with the dead soldier's gear (S1E13), Jean finding Marco (S1E13), and the Annie and Military Police subplot (S1E23). The first four are included lightly and the last is left out.
Optional anime-only cameos (Annie in the 845 ration line, and Reiner and Bertholdt at the 846 announcement in S1E2) are on screen but could tip off attentive viewers. Include them or not?

Naming conventions for on-screen labels: Survey Corps or Scout Regiment; Sina or Sheena; Karanes or Calaneth (the anime fandom uses Calaneth); Krolva or Klorva; Yarckel or Yalkell; Shadis or Sadies; Yeager or Jaeger; Mike or Miche. Quinta is light-novel-only, so leave it off the map or label it as such.
